name: FA complementation group I

function.text: FANCI encodes fanconi anemia group I protein. Annotated molecular activities include DNA polymerase binding. It participates in DNA damage response and interstrand cross-link repair.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Fanconi anemia complementation group I (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

function.text: FANCI encodes Fanconi anemia group I protein. Based in part on similarity, it contributes to the repair of DNA double-strand breaks by homologous recombination and in the repair of interstrand DNA cross-links (ICLs) by promoting FANCD2 monoubiquitination by FANCL and participating in recruitment to DNA repair sites. It participates in S phase and G2 phase checkpoint activation upon DNA damage.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Fanconi anemia complementation group I (autosomal recessive).
